method: Full 206820-character static text scanned; indexed class, methods, function declarations, ID occurrences, literal sprite metadata and imports/exports. No AST parser/runtime executed.
limitations: Minified one-line source: all offsets identify character ranges rather than useful line numbers.
Lexical method and symbol extraction is systematic but not a full JavaScript AST, so not all anonymous closures or nested object members are indexed individually.
Runtime and server authority unverified; no PNGs nor dependent imported modules supplied.
Dynamic class/skill registry construction documented by templates; generated IDs are not guaranteed to be exhaustive without execution.
unresolved_cross_module: PNG resource directories and optional additive light assets
